altitude.description: Surface altitude (m or ft, per units), 0 to 10000 m (32800 ft). Lowers the surface pressure depths are measured from. Default 0.

depth.description: Depth in m (metric) or ft (imperial) where to report PPO₂, END, EAD and gas density. Omit for MOD and minimum depth only.

helium_pct.description: Helium percentage of the mix, 0 to 95. Default 0 (nitrox or air).

o2_narcotic.description: Count oxygen as narcotic in the END. Default false (Dive Kit default).

oxygen_pct.description: Oxygen percentage of the mix, 5 to 100. Example: 32 for EANx32, 18 for 18/45. Required.

ppo2_max.description: PPO₂ limit in bar for the MOD, 1.0 to 1.6. Default: the Dive Kit band cap for the mix (1.4 under 28% O₂, 1.5 to under 45%, 1.6 at 45% and over). The MOD at 1.4 bar is always shown too.

temperature.description: Water temperature for gas density, in °C (metric, -2 to 40) or °F (imperial, 28 to 104). Default 15 °C.

units.description: metric (m, bar, L, °C) or imperial (ft, psi, ft³, °F): the unit system for every value in and out. Default metric.

water.description: Water type, from its density: en13319 (EN 13319, the dive computer standard) 10.00 m per bar, salt 9.95, fresh 10.20, red_sea 9.92. Default en13319.

name: gas_specs

caution.description: The most important caution at depth, if any.

min_depth.description: Shallowest depth where PPO₂ reaches 0.16 bar; 0 for normoxic mixes.

mod.description: Maximum operating depth at cap_used_bar, floored to 0.1.

mod_1_4_bar.description: MOD at 1.4 bar, the common working limit, when cap_used_bar is not 1.4.

nearest_standard_mix.description: Nearest standard trimix by composition (closest O₂ and He), for helium mixes. Not checked against any depth limit.

spoken_summary.description: A few plain sentences for a voice reply, ending with an offer: digits allowed, no symbols or notation.

units.description: metric (m, bar, L, °C) or imperial (ft, psi, ft³, °F): the unit system for every value in and out. Default metric.

title: Gas specs at depth
